title: Robust Flow Matching under Target Corruption and Label Noise
abstract: arXiv:2611.13324v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flow Matching (FM) is a strong framework for generative modeling due to its stable training and efficient sampling. However, FM assumes clean target data and labels, an assumption often violated in practice. We formulate FM training as a time-dependent regression problem over conditional vector fields and analyze how the two corruption types affect the objective: i) target corruption adds a time-dependent residual term that grows with time, ii) label noise causes updates to the wrong class-conditional vector field. Based on this analysis, we propose to improve FM robustness by mapping corruption-specific residual scores to sample weights. For target corruption, we propose the Temporal Residual Score (TRS), which emphasizes residual magnitudes at intermediate-to-late FM times, where clean and corrupted samples are more separable. translated_title: 目标污染与标签噪声下的鲁棒流匹配
translated_abstract: 流匹配因其稳定的训练和高效的采样而成为一种强大的生成建模框架。然而，流匹配假设目标数据和标签是干净的，这一假设在实践中经常被违反。我们将流匹配训练表述为条件向量场上的时变回归问题，并分析了两种污染类型如何影响目标函数：i) 目标污染会引入一个随时间增长的时变残差项；ii) 标签噪声会导致模型向错误的类条件向量场进行更新。基于这一分析，我们提出通过将特定于污染类型的残差分数映射为样本权重来提升流匹配的鲁棒性。针对目标污染，我们提出了时间残差分数，它强调流匹配中后期时间步的残差幅度，因为在这些阶段干净样本与受污染样本更容易区分。针对标签噪声，我们提出了比较条件分数，它通过比较观测到的残差……（原文摘要此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文将流匹配训练建模为条件向量场上的时变回归问题，系统分析了目标污染与标签噪声对训练目标的影响，并提出时间残差分数（TRS）与比较条件分数（CCS）两种残差驱动的样本加权策略，显著提升了流匹配在数据污染场景下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates Flow Matching training as a time-dependent regression problem, analyzes how target corruption and label noise affect the objective, and proposes the Temporal Residual Score (TRS) and Comparative Conditional Score (CCS) as residual-driven sample weighting strategies to significantly improve FM robustness under data corruption.
